schema.description: Workspace identifier
Layer identifier (the id of the layer actor)
Accepted for compatibility with legacy clients; ignored
Create/delete operations (1-500), applied in one transaction; deletes take effect before creates

action.description: create places the element on the layer, delete removes its placement

areaPicture.description: Picture stretched over an area (create node); makes the placement graphic: free position, no grid cell

id.description: Actor id (type node) or edge id (type edge); the actor or edge must already exist

laId.description: Placement id to delete (delete only). Without it, a delete removes every placement of the actor or edge on this layer

laIdSource.description: Placement id (laId) of the edge's source actor on this layer (create edge). Send both ends: an edge placement without them is not drawn by the current graph editor

laIdTarget.description: Placement id (laId) of the edge's target actor on this layer (create edge)

layerSettings.description: Placement display settings, stored as sent (create node); the keys are listed on graph/layer/actor_settings/save

anisotropy.description: Whether anisotropic texture filtering is enabled

expand.description: Whether the node is open in place, showing the content named by expandType

expandType.description: What an expanded node shows: cardView, chart, layer, profile, script (a Smart Form), actor (an actor page) or text

flaskView.description: Whether the node is rendered as a flask

fullScreen.description: Whether the expanded node is in full screen

height.description: Box height in graph units; same meaning as width

crop.description: Visible window into the source image

h.description: Height as a fraction of the source height

w.description: Width as a fraction of the source width

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the source width

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the source height

fit.description: How the bitmap fills its box (contain, cover, fill)

naturalHeight.description: Intrinsic height of the source image in pixels

naturalWidth.description: Intrinsic width of the source image in pixels

isCardView.description: Whether the node is rendered as a card

isTextNode.description: Whether the node is a text node

offset.description: How far an expanded node reaches past its cell. Typed here as {x, y}, while legacy clients and the graph editor store {top, right, bottom, left}: such a value reads back as {x: 0, y: 0}, and one sent here is stored as {x: 0, y: 0}. Do not send it

pin.description: Whether the node is pinned to this layer (cannot be dragged)

profile.description: Whether the profile view is shown

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation of an image placement, degrees

sizeGrade.description: Node size grade: S1 (one cell, the default), S2 or S3

userId.description: Author shown on a comment node: user id

userNick.description: Author shown on a comment node: display name

width.description: Box width in graph units: of a resizable placement (text, image), or of an actor's expanded content

zIndex.description: Stacking order: a higher value is drawn on top

polygon.description: Outline as [x, y] points in graph units (create node); makes the placement graphic

position.description: Position on the layer (create node); snapped to the 50-unit grid unless the placement is graphic; defaults to 0,0

x.description: X coordinate in graph units (grows to the right)

y.description: Y coordinate in graph units (grows downward)

type.description: node places an actor, edge places an existing edge between two placed actors
